notes.title: Get More Mystery with Kathy Rain: Director's Cut
notes.content:
Earlier this year, we were thrilled to have the opportunity to expand on The Signifier and bring you our ultimate vision for what the game could become. Knowing what a joy it is to expand on a story you're passionate about, we're excited to see fellow Raw Fury developer Clifftop Games revist their award-winning point-and-click detective adventure Kathy Rain, with a new Director's Cut that just released yesterday!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37118519/da851928d6e05b182c6479591796ff6e26a09447.gif

A bit about the game from the Kathy Rain: Director's Cut store page: 

Kathy is a strong-willed journalism major who must come to terms with her troubled past as she investigates the mysterious death of her recently departed grandfather.

Armed with her motorcycle, a pack of cigs, and a notepad, Kathy delves into a local mystery surrounding her hometown that will take her on a harrowing journey of emotional and personal turmoil.

As she follows a trail of clues left by her grandfather, questions emerge: What was Joseph Rain really looking for that night all those years ago? What turned him into a mere shell of a man, confined to a wheelchair? What secret did a suicidal young artist take with her to the grave, and why are so many people in Conwell Springs going mad? The truth is dark, sinister, and yours to uncover…

In this investigative thriller, you will do things like:


 Collect clues and make deductions
 Analyze evidence
 Interrogate suspects
 Solve cryptic puzzles

---

For those of you who loved the investigative elements of The Signifier, we hope you'll find Kathy Rain: Director's Cut to be similarly puzzling and captivating. To get a sense for the game before you dig in, check out their launch trailer here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395030/Kathy_Rain_Directors_Cut/

notes.title: The Signifier: Director's Cut Patch 1.101
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37118519/34550a1f427e82a0c0b19f5c11434bbdcf3e4506.png

Patch DC 1.101 Notes:

- Stuttering: Greatly reduced stuttering in high fps/high refresh rate setups.
- Remapping: Now you can remap to the numpad.
- Fixed a bug that would make the subtitles when inspecting objects overlap with previous subtitles.
- Fixed pressing Button for objectives not working on some controllers
- New Game / Load: Fixed a bug that could prevent you from starting a new game while the game was already running.
- UI: Arrows for selecting slots with a mouse are more responsive.
- Localization German: In the Dream scene, there was some German lines that were cut off (fixed, thanks Marko!)
- Dream scene: Boiler area had too many overlapping sounds, better mixing.
- Recall Raw Data: Fixed a bug that would prevent you from using recall raw data in the club.
- Minor usability tips in final memory.
- Better sound mixing in some scenes where the dialogue was too low.
- A lot of typo fixes. 
- Fixed some of the eye icons not becoming dark when you already listened to the available text.
- Bigger hitboxes in some areas.


We'll keep working on better support for other controllers (besides xbox and ps), and keep an eye on the forums for any issues you may have :). Thanks for all the feedback!

notes.title: Director's Cut Update
notes.content:
The Director's Cut Update which launches today opens the door to the ultimate experience of The Signifier. 

From the outset of development, we set our sights on creating an experience able to completely immerse you in a mind-bending story. The game plays on exuberance for advances in technology turned to deeply unsettling confrontation with objective memories and subjective responses to personal experiences, creating a unique blend of dramatic and atmospheric tension that only increases as you play. Fictional advanced AI-assisted experimental psychology provides the doorway into surreal reconstructions that blur the lines between real and perceived, memory and dream.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37118519/d19b2a1d6fb1f525a5af807624dc7dcb6985b620.jpg
 
Whether your first playthrough or a return, the Director's Cut swallows you into this world only to be spit out at the end needing time to digest and understand. Get to know the characters better with expanded dialog, dive deeper into the story through added interactions, and make different choices on repeat playthroughs to reach more endings. 

Imagine entering the mind of another person, seeing what they saw, experiencing their life's moments, knowing their innermost secrets, and facing how they died. This is The Signifier Director's Cut.

notes.title: Inside the Director’s Cut Update
notes.content:
Launching our first game brought an unbelievable feeling to everyone at Playmesudio. When we saw players connect with The Signifier and read the positive reviews, that made all the work that went into the game so worth it. In an instant we felt more than just relief; we felt energized. We knew we wanted to reach the full vision we saw so close in reach.

We decided to go for it and create a Director’s Cut that goes as extra level in everything to deliver on our research and preproduction. And we made it a free update so everyone, those who played and loved the Signifier and those for whom this will be their first time playing it, get the ultimate experience.

With the update set to release Thursday 22 April, it's time to share some details!
STORY
A lot of the work went into better developing connections in the second half of the game. With multiple layers and complex characters, the big picture of The Signifier seemed to overshadow little things we wanted players to get. New dialog, lore items like personal notes, emails, and articles, and a full epilogue bring out great subtleties. Players will learn much more about each of the characters and the experiences that happened in each location. Important choices that shape the outcome are highlighted to be better recognized. And their results come through stronger than ever with three new endings in addition to the original three.
GAMEPLAY
Next, we set out to make it as easy as possible for players to experience the full story of The Signifier. That work started with making objectives clearer, and then providing additional feedback in places where the way forward was not always apparent. Even so, for players wanting a cinematic experience we added a new easy mode. In it, players get direct guidance on what to do next from the EVEE artificial intelligence in the game. This mode can also be switched to and from at will to get a little help when you want it and not when you do not. Other little improvements like controller mapping, improving the feel of interactions, and adding more save slots add a little extra polish.
PERFORMANCE & VISUALS
To complete the package, we went through the code to find every optimization possible to benefit machines of every spec. We were able to greatly reduce memory usage and improve framerate throughout. The result has the game feeling responsive overall. Playing at 4k on a mid-range PC is totally doable, and high-end PC's will get over 60fps. Topping it all off, completely revamped character animations make immersion in the game world that much more complete.

Enjoy the ultimate expression of The Signifier
Whether you’re coming back, or this will be the first time, we hope each playthrough of The Signifier with the Director’s Cut update brings you enjoyment and leads to exploring new questions.

-The Playmestudio Team

notes.title: First Look! The Signifier: Director’s Cut today at Game Dev Direct
notes.content:
Free Director's Cut Update Coming Soon!

In December, we shared here on Steam that there was more of The Signifier to come. The initial release was a huge moment for us, and seeing you all respond to the game showed us just how much more of the story we wanted to tell. After taking in your feedback, exploring which areas of the game we could expand, and spending a few months in development, we’re just about ready to show you how The Signifier will change in the new Director’s Cut.

Please join us at Game Dev Direct to see the latest trailer, premiering today (Saturday) around 9:30am PST / 6:30pm CET at MediaIndieExchange on Twitch

We’re excited to share even more about what to expect from The Signifier: Director’s Cut, so look out for a post soon with a preview of the new content and technical improvements to come.

notes.title: New Patch!
notes.content:
Hello! A new patch is live, fixing the issues that were happening in only a few setups, plus some optimizations. Big thanks to all the feedback and to the people that shared their logs and time to test with us :). Hope you enjoy the journey!

Patch notes:

 Fixed controller issues in some setups. Important: If you use Steam Input for PS4 or XBOX controllers in global steam settings (off by default), you need to turn it off for The Signifier in the game's properties ( "Steam Input Per-Game Setting").
 Fixed possible crash when changing location the game in a few setups.
 Fixed rare bug that would prevent some users to Load a savegame.
 Fixed a bug that would keep Raw Data available even after it was solved in a few setups.
 Fixed some saves that would save at the beggining of a location but would make you appear at the end of the last one, confusing the player.
 Fixed an issue that would prevent getting the achievement "A different person".
 Fixed an issue that would make the game load forever when entering the machine for the first time in some setups (codec issue).
 Fixed an issue that would prevent players from changing states with Q.
 Hitbox for videologs in warehouse bigger for visibility.
 Fixed a rare bug in which the player was not able to retain control after talking with Stan.
 Fixed an issue that would make the text "new" to never go away in the event 2 of the club, confusing the player.
 Other minor optimizations and typo fixes.

notes.title: Dreamwalker Video Logs on YouTube
notes.content:
YouTube Video Series Shows Goes Inside the Dreamwalker Project in The Signifier

The Dreamwalker project proposes a combination of deep brain scanning, artificial intelligence interpretation, and virtualization that allows exploration of the unconsciousness. These videos offer a deep dive into the operation of the system, some of the challenges faced in its development, and a personal look at the researchers as they describe their creation.

Watch the series on The Signifier YouTube playlist

The Signifier launches Thursday, 15 October!

Video game critics got a good look at The Signifier during Gamescom 2020 and came back with a lot to say. Some highlights with links to the full articles follow. notes.title: The Signifier Releases 15 October!
notes.content:
Play the Signifier starting 15 October!

Your journey into the unconsciousness in search of answers to a mysterious death draws near. When the vice president of the world's largest tech company turns up dead in her home, it’s up to you to examine her death using advanced technology to interpret the mind and solve the mystery. Step foot into the Dreamwalker, a deep brain scanner which recreates recorded senses in the virtual world, and venture into the memories of the deceased.
